full_command: As night falls, Ethan Edwards and Martin Pawley stand on the porch of their cabin, gazing at the starry sky. Suddenly, they hear a distant gunshot, prompting them to draw their weapons and prepare for action. The scene shifts to a dusty frontier town square, where they confront a group of outlaws led by the charismatic but ruthless Charlie McCorry. The tension is palpable as the two cowboys face off against their adversaries, with the iconic stone buildings and wooden structures of the town providing a stark backdrop to the impending showdown.
